translation: For all cold pain, when it also involves Shaoyin and the Ren meridian, Sini Tang governs it; when it also involves Jueyin, Danggui Sini Tang; when it also involves Taiyin, Lizhong Tang. For all heat pain, when it also involves Shaoyin and the Ren meridian, Jinling San (Melia-toosendan Powder) and Yanhusuo San (Corydalis Powder); when it also involves Jueyin, Shixiao San (Laughing-Dispersion Powder). When it also involves Taiyin, Chengqi Tang (Qi-Carrying Decoction) governs it.
